nameOrigin: to drive animals (e.g. sheep) into a group

pokedexEntries.bk: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

pokedexEntries.wh: It loyally follows its Trainer’s orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.x: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.or: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.y: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

pokedexEntries.as: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

pokedexEntries.su: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

pokedexEntries.mo: This Pokémon obeys its master’s orders faithfully. However, it refuses to listen to anything said by a person it doesn’t respect.

pokedexEntries.us: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can’t easily penetrate it.

pokedexEntries.um: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.

pokedexEntries.sw: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.

pokedexEntries.sh: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.
